trello.name: Benchmark PgBouncer for dashboard connection pooling
trello.desc:
Nadia: Agreed. Let's settle it now: we're staying on Postgres, no migration, no evaluation task, I don't want that on the board. But the contention is real, so Raj, take a proper look at connection pooling instead. Benchmark PgBouncer in transaction mode against our current setup, with the dashboard workload, and bring numbers next sync.
Raj: Will do. I'll set up a load test that mirrors the dashboard's query pattern and compare p95 latency with and without PgBouncer.

trello.name: Fix typo in onboarding email subject line
trello.desc:
Nadia: Marketing spotted a typo in the onboarding email, it says "recieve" in the subject line, of all places. Tom, just fix it and get it re-approved, five-minute job.
Tom: On it. I'll push the fix through the email template repo today.

trello.name: Update roadmap doc for dark mode placement
trello.desc:
Nadia: And the roadmap doc still shows dark mode under "Q3 committed", which after today is wrong. Tom, while you're in there, update the roadmap: move dark mode under the September design-system upgrade line so sales stops promising it as standalone.
Tom: Got it, I'll update the doc right after this.
